{Am}Oyfn for{E7}el {Am}ligt a {E7}kelbl,
{Am}ligt gebu{Dm}ndn  {Am}mit a {E7}shtrik
{Am}hoykh in hi{E7}ml {Am}flit a {E7}foygl,
{Am}flit un dre{Dm}yt zikh {Am}hin un {E7}ts'rik.
 

{G}Lakht der vind in {C}korn,
{G}lakht un lakht un {C}lakht
{G}lakht er op a {C}tog a {Am}gantsn
{E7}un a halbe na{Am}cht.
{E7}Donaj, donaj, donaj, do{Am}naj,
{G}donaj, donaj, donaj-{C}daj.
{E7}Donaj, donaj, donaj, do{Am}naj,
{E7}donaj, donaj, donaj-{Am}daj.
 

Shreyt dos kelbl, zogt der poyer:
"Ver - zhe heyst dikh zayn a kalb?
Voltst gekent, doch zayn a foygl,
voltst gekent doch zayn a shvalb!"
 

Bidne kelblekh tut men bindn,
un men shlept zey un men shekht.
Ver's hot fligl, flit aroyf tsu,
is bay keynem nisht keyn knekht.
title: Dos Kelbl
